title: Calendar
intro: With the calendar configured, the agent checks free slots in the Bitrix24 Calendar, books appointments for the customer and tells them what they already have scheduled. Slots follow the agent's business hours; without them, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Brasília time) applies.
scopeMissing: Bitrix24 denied access to the Calendar. A portal administrator needs to reauthorize the app with the Calendar permission (reinstall the app) so the agent can use the calendar.
crmRequired: The calendar only works with this agent's CRM access turned on. Turn it on in "CRM access" below.
staleLoadError: {error} What appears below may be outdated.
outOfSync: The agent was not found in GPTMaker. Until this is resolved, the calendar cannot be changed.
empty: The agent does not offer or book appointments yet.

modeHints.FIXED_USER: Appointments go on the calendar of a Bitrix24 user.
modeHints.CLIENT_OWNER: Appointments go on the calendar of whoever owns the conversation's customer in the CRM.
modeHints.USER_LIST: The agent offers the free slots of any of the users and books with the first one on the list who is free.

attendantListHint: If a user is busy at that time, the appointment goes to the next one on the list. Up to {max} users.
noticeHint: From {min} to {max}. The agent does not offer slots sooner than this.
daysLabel: Look for slots up to (days ahead)
confirmBody: The agent stops offering and booking appointments. Appointments already booked in Bitrix24 stay on the calendar. You can configure the calendar again whenever you want.
loadError: Could not load the agent's calendar.
saveError: Could not save the calendar. Try again.
removeError: Could not remove the calendar. Try again.
fillNumbers: Fill in the duration, the notice and the window with numbers.

validation.slotInt: The duration must be a whole number of minutes
validation.slotStep: Use a duration in multiples of {step} minutes
validation.noticeInt: The notice must be a whole number of minutes
validation.daysInt: The window must be a whole number of days
validation.usersRepeated: There are repeated users in the list
validation.usersFixed: In fixed user mode, choose exactly 1 user
validation.usersList: In the user list, choose from 1 to {max} users
validation.usersOwner: In customer's owner mode, there are no users to choose

summary.clientOwner: the customer's owner in the CRM
summary.rules: {slot}-minute appointments · minimum notice: {notice} · searching up to {days} ahead.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Review them and try again.
errors.CALENDAR_CRM_REQUIRED: Turn on this agent's CRM access to configure the calendar.
errors.CALENDAR_USER_INVALID: Some users do not exist in Bitrix24 or are inactive. Choose other users.
errors.CALENDAR_PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE: Bitrix24 did not respond. Wait a moment and try again.
